curves.name: Typical Transfer Characteristics at 25 deg C
curves.test_conditions: VDS = 15 V, 20 us pulse width, TJ = 25 deg C

extraction_notes: All nine pages of the supplied canonical PDF were examined.
The 25 deg C transfer curve on page 3 was digitized as approximate points from the published logarithmic plot without interpolation beyond the visible trace.
Tabulated capacitances were converted from pF to F and tabulated resistances from ohms without changing the published values.
The datasheet publishes threshold minimum and maximum values but no threshold typical value.
omission_reason: Only the nominal 25 deg C transfer characteristic was digitized. Output-characteristic families and other plots were not needed to preserve the constrained scalar evidence, and no points were invented from obscured or ambiguous traces.
